item.title: ALTER READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ENABLE/DISABLE
item.description:
Description

The ALTER READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ENABLE/DISABLE syntax is used to enable/disable a specified read source for specified readwrite-splitting rule.

Syntax

AlterReadwriteSplittingRule ::=
  'ALTER' 'READWRITE_SPLITTING' 'RULE' ruleName ('ENABLE' | 'DISABLE') storageUnitName ('FROM' databaseName)?

ruleName ::=
  identifier

storageUnitName ::=
  identifier

databaseName ::=
  identifier

Supplement

  • When databaseName is not specified, the default is the currently used DATABASE. If DATABASE is not used, No database selected will be prompted.

Example

  • Disable a specified read source for specified readwrite-splitting rule in specified database
ALTER READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0 DISABLE read_ds_0 FROM sharding_db;
  • Enable a specified read source for specified readwrite-splitting rule in specified database
ALTER READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0 ENABLE read_ds_0 FROM sharding_db;
  • Disable a specified read source for specified readwrite-splitting rule in current database
ALTER READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0 DISABLE read_ds_0;
  • Enable a specified read source for specified readwrite-splitting rule in current database
ALTER READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_1 ENABLE read_ds_0;

Reserved word

ALTER, READWRITE_SPLITTING, RULE, ENABLE, DISABLE, FROM

item.title: SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE
item.description:
Description

The SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE syntax is used to query readwrite-splitting storage unit status for specified readwrite-splitting rule in specified database.

Syntax

ShowStatusFromReadwriteSplittingRules ::=
  'SHOW' 'STATUS' 'FROM' 'READWRITE_SPLITTING' ('RULES' | 'RULE' groupName) ('FROM' databaseName)?

groupName ::=
  identifier

databaseName ::=
  identifier

Supplement

  • When databaseName is not specified, the default is the currently used DATABASE. If DATABASE is not used, No database selected will be prompted.

Return Value Description

Columns Description
name readwrite-splitting rule name
storage_unit storage unit name
status storage unit status

Example

  • Query readwrite-splitting storage unit status for specified readwrite-splitting rule in specified database.
SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0 FROM sharding_db;
mysql> SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0 FROM sharding_db;
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| name        | storage_unit | status   |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| ms_group_0  | ds_0         | disabled |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
  • Query all readwrite-splitting storage unit status from specified database.
SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULES FROM sharding_db;
mysql> SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULES FROM sharding_db;
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| name        | storage_unit | status   |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| ms_group_0  | ds_0         | disabled |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
  • Query readwrite-splitting storage unit status for specified readwrite-splitting rule in current database
SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0;
mysql> SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_0;
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| name        | storage_unit | status   |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| ms_group_0  | ds_0         | disabled |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)
  • Query all readwrite-splitting storage unit status from current database.
SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULES;
mysql> SHOW STATUS FROM READWRITE_SPLITTING RULES;
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| name        | storage_unit | status   |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
| ms_group_0  | ds_0         | disabled |
+-------------+--------------+----------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)

Reserved word

SHOW, STATUS, FROM, READWRITE_SPLITTING, RULE, RULES

item.title: SHOW COMPUTE NODES
item.description:
Description

The SHOW COMPUTE NODES syntax is used to query compute nodes information.

Syntax

ShowComputeNodes ::=
  'SHOW' 'COMPUTE' 'NODES'

Return Value Description

Columns Description
instance_id instance id
instance_type instance type
host host
port port
status status
mode_type mode type
worker_id worker id
version version
database_name database name (Only valid for JDBC)

Example

mysql> SHOW COMPUTE NODES;
+--------------------------------------+---------------+------------+------+--------+------------+-----------+---------------------------+--------------+
| instance_id                          | instance_type | host       | port | status | mode_type  | worker_id | version                   | database_name |
+--------------------------------------+---------------+------------+------+--------+------------+-----------+---------------------------+--------------+
| 3e84d33e-cb97-42f2-b6ce-f78fea0ded89 | PROXY         | 127.0.0.1  | 3307 | OK     | Cluster    | -1        | ${latest.release.version} | logic_db      |
+--------------------------------------+---------------+------------+------+--------+------------+-----------+---------------------------+--------------+
1 row in set (0.01 sec)

Dedicated Terminology

SHOW, COMPUTE, NODES

item.title: ENABLE/DISABLE COMPUTE NODE
item.description:
Description

The ENABLE/DISABLE COMPUTE NODE syntax is used to enable or disable a specified compute node in cluster mode.

Syntax

EnableDisableComputeNode ::=
  ('ENABLE' | 'DISABLE') 'COMPUTE' 'NODE' instanceId

instanceId ::=
  string

Supplement

  • instanceId needs to be obtained through SHOW COMPUTE NODES syntax query

  • The compute node executing this statement cannot be disabled.

Example

  • Disable a specified compute node
DISABLE COMPUTE NODE '734bb086-b15d-4af0-be87-2372d8b6a0cd';
  • Enable a specified compute node
ENABLE COMPUTE NODE '734bb086-b15d-4af0-be87-2372d8b6a0cd';

Reserved word

ENABLE, DISABLE, COMPUTE, NODE
